paragraphs.text: Kawit was an Amonkheti warrior, who became Oketra 's avenger. She tried to kill God-Pharaoh during the Final Hours .

Kawit was overwhelmed with rage after her god, Oketra , was killed. Kneeling beside Oketra's body, she picked up one of the god's arrows, feeling a lingering divine energy within it. When a minotaur Eternal attacked, Kawit killed it with the arrow, which disintegrated the creature in a flash of white light. She had become Oketra's Avenger.

Spotting the God-Pharaoh , who was revealed to be a dragon , Kawit challenged him, vowing to kill him for the destruction and betrayal he had caused. Eternals tried to stop her as she charged, but a glowing shield, a manifestation of Oketra's love, protected her. She threw the spear at the dragon, but he effortlessly stopped it mid-air, dismissing her with bemused indifference.
Her shield flickered and vanished, and as the Eternals closed in, Kawit, utterly defeated by the dragon's disregard, lacked the strength even to scream.
She became part of the Dreadhorde on Ravnica and was re-killed by Samut .
